limitations: Chronological generator runs on explicit standalone input; default source 2.6 pricing/panel/baskets/returns path is unchanged and not yet integrated.
Inventory snapshots and stockout episodes are not implemented in this scope; final balances are diagnostics only.
Reservation policy none; instant partial fulfillment; no reserve/release state machine or backorders.
Coverage certifies processed observable windows, not latent demand or complete future corrections; reviews still filter actual availability.
Original fulfillment warehouse is required for returns; accepted restocks, rejected returns refund without restock.
Supplier fulfillment eventually receives the full order; no permanent failures/cancellations/approvals.
Full generator report includes separate simulation truth; it is not an API/feature export.
Receipt tail remains private and unexecuted; immature outcomes cannot qualify future stockout labels.
DATA-06 and full source/readiness gates stay open; no new source/curated IDs or model metrics.
Local branch commits only; no remote Required CI or main publication for AI 06.4.
